-- Good - asdkey = abkey. Now let me build the full query to calculate PFIS, FRAI, RDD for facilities with >20% high-risk prevalence

-- PFIS: Average functional impairment score (Mild=1, Moderate=2, Severe=3) for ALL assessments at facility
-- FRAI: Based on community_resources from facilities table (Limited=1, Adequate=2, Comprehensive=3)
-- RDD: PFIS - FRAI

SELECT e.facid, 
       COUNT(*) as total_assessments,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_risk_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as prevalence_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Mild' THEN 1 WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Severe' THEN 3 END)::numeric, 2) as pfis,
       CASE f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' 
           WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 END as frai_score,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Mild' THEN 1 WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Severe' THEN 3 END)::numeric, 2) - 
       CASE f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' 
           WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 END as rdd
FROM encounters e
JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON e.abref = ab.abkey
JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk a ON ab.abkey = a.asrkey
LEFT JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON ab.abkey = asd.asdkey
JOIN facilities f ON e.facid = f.fackey
GROUP BY e.facid, f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources'
HAVING ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) > 20
